notes.title: 🛠️ Dev Update: The Game Is Getting Exciting! 🔥🎮
notes.notes:
🚧 Hard at Work! 💪
Hey everyone! I’ve been working day and night on Polygon Bit Battle Royale, and it’s really starting to come together. The game is getting more exciting with every update, and I can’t wait to show you more soon!

📝 Please wishlist the game to support development and stay in the loop for the launch. Your support means everything! 🙏

Stay tuned — big things are coming! 🚀
